name: Hardcoded Password
description: Hardcoded password found in application code or string resources.
reason: Hardcoded credentials can be extracted using decompile tools and used to compromise remote accounts or API endpoints.
recommendation: Never hardcode passwords in the application. Authenticate users via tokens or OAuth flow.

name: Hardcoded API Key / Access Token
description: Hardcoded API key, OAuth secret, or JWT token detected.
reason: Exposing API keys in compiled APK files allows unauthorized third parties to steal API usage quotas or access cloud backends.
recommendation: Store secrets securely on a backend server or proxy requests through a secure gateway.

name: Insecure Storage in SharedPreferences / SQLite
description: Sensitive keys, passwords, or tokens stored in plaintext SharedPreferences or unencrypted SQLite databases.
reason: Data stored unencrypted in application sandbox files can be read on rooted devices or via ADB backup.
recommendation: Use `EncryptedSharedPreferences` or SQLCipher for database encryption.
